workspace.title: Admin Dashboard
workspace.subtitle: Welcome back, {name}. Full system overview and management.

tasks.title: All Tasks
tasks.caption: All review tasks across every developer and customer
tasks.emptyHint: Tasks appear here as soon as developers create them.

assign.title: Assign Reviewer
assign.label: Reviewer
assign.ownerExcluded: The developer who raised the task cannot review it.
assign.noReviewers: No active reviewer is eligible for this task.

cancel.title: Cancel this task?
cancel.description: {taskCode} will be closed and can no longer be reviewed. The record is kept.

delete.title: Delete this task?
delete.description: {taskCode} and everything attached to it will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.
delete.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this task must be permanently deleted
delete.onlyDraftOrCancelled: Only a draft or cancelled task can be deleted.

users.title: User Management
users.subtitle: Manage user roles and access
users.caption: All portal users, their roles and their status
users.emptyHint: Add the first user to give someone access to the portal.
users.emptyFilteredTitle: No users match the selected filters.
users.emptyFilteredHint: Try adjusting your search query, role selection, or status filter.
users.editSubtitle: Change this user's details and access

privileged.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this privileged access is changing
privileged.reasonRequired: Provide a reason for this privileged change.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this user?
deactivate.description: {name} will not be able to sign in. Their tasks and review history are kept.

delete.title: Delete this user?
delete.description: {name} will be permanently removed. This is only possible for a user with no tasks or reviews.
delete.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this account must be permanently deleted

checklist.title: Quality Checklist
checklist.subtitle: Maintain the task types, categories and questions developers answer
checklist.retiredNote: Inactive rows stay listed here. A submitted checklist keeps its own copy of the wording, so deactivating a question never changes a past review.

questions.caption: Every checklist question, its category and the task types it applies to
questions.emptyHint: Add a category first, then the questions that belong to it.
questions.addSubtitle: A new question in the developer quality checklist
questions.editSubtitle: Change the wording, category or task types
questions.textPlaceholder: e.g. Have you added unit tests for the new logic?
questions.appliesToHint: The question appears only for the task types selected here.
questions.orderHint: Lower numbers appear first within the category. Leave blank to add at the end.

duplicateOrder.title: Order {order} is already in use
duplicateOrder.description: Another question in {category} already sits at this position.
duplicateOrder.body: “{text}” currently holds order {order} in {category}. Choose how to place the new question.
duplicateOrder.keepBothHint: The new question takes order {order}. Everything from there down in {category} moves one place later.
duplicateOrder.replaceHint: The existing question is deleted and the new one takes its place. No other question moves.

reorder.handle: Reorder question: {text}. Drag it, or use the arrow keys.
reorder.unsavedHint: Keep rearranging as long as you like — nothing is written until you save.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this question?
deactivate.description: It stops appearing on new checklists. Checklists already submitted are unchanged.

delete.title: Delete this question?
delete.description: It is removed from the bank permanently. Only possible for a question nobody has answered.

categories.caption: Checklist categories and their display order
categories.emptyHint: A category groups related questions — Reservation, Code, Unit Testing.
categories.addSubtitle: A new grouping for checklist questions
categories.editSubtitle: Rename the category or change where it appears
categories.orderHint: Lower numbers appear first. Leave blank to add at the end.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this category?
deactivate.description: {name} and its questions stop appearing on new checklists.

delete.title: Delete this category?
delete.description: {name} is removed permanently. Only possible for a category with no questions.

reorder.handle: Reorder category: {name}. Drag it, or use the arrow keys.
reorder.unsavedHint: Keep rearranging as long as you like — nothing is written until you save.

taskTypes.caption: Task types, which decide the questions a developer is asked
taskTypes.emptyHint: A task type decides which questions a developer is asked.
taskTypes.addSubtitle: A new kind of work developers can raise
taskTypes.editSubtitle: Rename the task type or change where it appears
taskTypes.orderHint: Lower numbers appear first on the checklist step. Leave blank to add at the end.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this task type?
deactivate.description: {name} can no longer be chosen on new tasks. Existing tasks keep it.

delete.title: Delete this task type?
delete.description: {name} is removed permanently. Only possible when no task and no question refers to it.

reorder.handle: Reorder task type: {name}. Drag it, or use the arrow keys.
reorder.unsavedHint: Keep rearranging as long as you like — nothing is written until you save.

handovers.title: Handovers
handovers.subtitle: Reviews handed back for reassignment
handovers.caption: Tasks a reviewer handed back, and what happened to them
handovers.pendingNote: Handed-over tasks stay out of the Available queue until they are reassigned or returned, preventing multiple reviewers from claiming the same task.
handovers.emptyHint: A reviewer who cannot finish a review hands it back here.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Search by Task ID, Title, CRIM ID, Reviewer, or Reason...
filters.emptyTitle: No handovers match the selected filters.
filters.emptyHint: Adjust the filters or clear them to see all handovers.

reassign.title: Reassign this review
reassign.description: {taskCode} was handed back by {name}. Choose who picks it up.
reassign.label: Reviewer
reassign.hint: The reviewer who handed it over and the developer who raised it are both excluded.
reassign.noReviewers: No other active reviewer is eligible for this task.

return.title: Return this task to the queue?
return.description: {taskCode} becomes available for any reviewer to pick up. No one is assigned.

reports.title: Reports & Analytics
reports.subtitle: Comprehensive insights into code review performance

charts.statusSubtitle: Current status of all review tasks
charts.rankSubtitle: Code quality based on review outcomes
charts.cycleSubtitle: Number of review iterations to approval
charts.empty: No data for the selected filters

developers.title: Developer Performance
developers.subtitle: Individual developer metrics and code quality trends
developers.empty: No developer has raised a task under these filters.

reviewers.title: Reviewer Activity
reviewers.subtitle: Review patterns and feedback metrics by reviewer
reviewers.empty: No reviewer has completed a review under these filters.

customers.title: Customer Overview
customers.subtitle: Task distribution and quality metrics by customer
customers.empty: No customer has tasks under these filters.

customers.title: Customer Management
customers.subtitle: Manage customer records
customers.caption: All customers, their colour and their status
customers.emptyHint: Add a customer before raising the first review task.
customers.colorHint: Select a color theme for this customer. This color will be used throughout the app for visual identification.
customers.codeHint: The code is generated from the name and becomes the prefix of every Task ID for this customer, so it cannot be changed later.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this customer?
deactivate.description: {name} will no longer be selectable on new tasks. Existing tasks are unaffected.

delete.title: Delete this customer?
delete.description: {name} will be permanently removed. This is only possible for a customer with no tasks.
delete.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this customer must be permanently deleted
